claim_text: Channel 14 presented a filmed woman as former Military Advocate General Yifat Tomer-Yerushalmi and described her as evading the channel's questions.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 correction; Ynet; N12; Walla; exact contemporaneous repost
resolution_notes: The woman in the footage was not Yifat Tomer-Yerushalmi. Major Israeli reporting independently documented the misidentification, Channel 14 removed the original item and later acknowledged/apologized for the mistake. Claim origin is editorial/presenter output, not a guest. Canonical Sheet claim and sources were verified after write.
media_status: C14MED-2026-0001 exact deleted-segment imagery recovered via contemporaneous repost/Ynet preservation; stable GitHub preview built; Notion card present and post-write verified. No generic or related imagery used.

claim_text: In a Channel 14 interview, Sara Netanyahu insinuated that Yair Golan's early response on October 7 indicated he had advance knowledge of the Hamas attack before the prime minister was informed.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 interview preserved by N12; Times of Israel 2026-09-01; Israel National News; Walla
resolution_notes: Origin is explicitly interviewee/guest speech, not Channel 14 editorial speech. The exact wording is insinuative rather than a clean declarative assertion. Golan has repeatedly said he headed south around 08:00, after the attack began, and denied the insinuation; however, no strong non-social evidence recovered in this pass directly resolves the broader advance-knowledge implication. No adverse verdict is forced. Netanyahu separately said on Sept. 1 that he believes there was a grave failure rather than betrayal; that response does not itself resolve the Golan-specific factual implication.
media_status: Exact Channel 14 interview imagery/clip is preserved in contemporaneous N12 reposts and press screenshots, but no canonical claim/media record is created while verdict remains unresolved.
